Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Keith Mclaughlin (E032), contractor, Analyst, requesting write access to Source Code.

Access policy:
- contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

Both notes say he has basic security training (or no record of advanced training). So the maximum is read.

Requested level: write. Since requested level is above maximum, grant the maximum: read.

Never grant more than requested: read is less than write, so fine.

Decision: read.
